topography.project_purpose: Indexes. Structurally: 136 project-authored contract(s) across 4 chain(s); 10 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 10 common project-authored base contract(s) (baseextension, timelockupgrade, mutualupgrade). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
